week1_watches.theme: Capability jumps that change product bets
week1_watches.watch: Frontier / open-weight releases with published eval deltas OR API price/rate changes that rewrite unit economics for builders.
week1_watches.second_order: Changes roadmap and margin assumptions inside one planning cycle.
week1_watches.displace_what: Generic 'AI breakthrough' headline pile with no shipping or pricing receipt.
week1_watches.why_in: Capability + economics moves that force a product decision within weeks.
week1_watches.why_out: Benchmark theater, model-card screenshots, or rumor with no primary/shipping path.

self_kill_attempt.claim_we_might_be_wrong: The 'unit economics rewrite defaults' frame overstates decision impact: Flash already wins list price by ~10× so the Sep moves are incremental not regime-changing for cost buyers; Fable's 25–45% savings are vendor-estimated on one usage mix; Astra Fast 2× is optional; and much agentic spend may ride seat licenses / cloud credits / distribution, not raw API list — so pricing footnotes may be noise vs capability/harness/distribution (Leg B wins by default without Contested theater).
evidence_that_would_retire_it: Primary share or procurement data showing default agentic production lanes chosen by non-API instruments (seats, credits, exclusive distribution) with list price inert
Primary pricing pages retract or contradict the three-lane numbers
Independent same-harness cost-per-task across Fable/Astra/Flash showing lanes converge within noise so economics cannot displace capability
self_kill_attempt.outcome_note: Job B falsify upgrade (TBL). Pricing Primaries still corroborate three-lane numbers — pricing_contradiction kill fails. kill_LegA fails — no Primary procurement share proving list price inert; OpenAI Enterprise token-based rate card cuts the other way. Upgrade: Specialist token-intensity/cache receipts now on the Contested surface — DeepSWE same-harness Astra~$6.52/~30k out vs Flash~$2.36/~143k at tied 74%; AA Fable 5.1 ~1.7× output tokens vs Fable 5 ($3.76/task despite cache cut); Firecrawl measured Claude-lane cache re-reads (e.g. 1.69M cached for $0.42 vs Fable 5 1.34M/$1.34). Hold Contested: Legs A/B both live; confidence null; never averaged. Gap remains: no independent same-harness cost-per-task jointly including Fable 5.1 + Astra + Flash. EXAMPLE stays retired (example:false). Hunt: data/tbl_job_b_falsify_hunt.json.

week1_watches.why_in: Distribution levers move customer outcomes faster than raw model quality.
week1_watches.why_out: Soft 'exploring partnership' language with no terms, defaults, or dates.
week1_watches.why: Live P1 under D-020; P0 Contested stays; falsify-at-open complete

self_kill_attempt.claim_we_might_be_wrong: Distribution/platform-power may not displace capability this planning cycle: named 'default model' and app-store AI surface changes often slip, get A/B-limited, or leave API buyers on raw capability/price — so ship-date press without contract, default switch, or measured traffic share is theater, not allocate/partner/distribute signal.
evidence_that_would_retire_it: Hyperscaler or major product primary docs show no default-model / hosting-default change shipped in the named window (slip or cancel with primary receipt)
Independent traffic or attach share shows capability/price lanes winning customers despite a shipped platform default (distribution lever inert)
OS/app-store AI surface change ships without a named partner or allocate decision path for builders (no decision surface left)
self_kill_attempt.outcome_note: Falsify-at-open filed at lighting under D-020. Assassination not yet run — intake gate satisfied. example:false only; no card until CIO/CSO collect with Primaries.
